about: Round five: twenty questions a coach brings, written against each member's week in data/demo.json (goal, up19, situations and heroes). Each holds the reading a coach means: the facets in q are exact, and any facet not listed must be absent. 'sitFirst' asks only for the situation read first. 'unread' lists words the reading still leaves, said honestly; 'read' lists words it must use. Lead checks name the story, or a property of it.
